title: 云中谁寄锦书来？雁字回时，月满西楼。
description: 满月照着中式西楼，一人在木廊上望向归雁，掌中的素封信笺仍未展开。

source_text.text: 云中谁寄锦书来？雁字回时，月满西楼。
source_text.author: 李清照
source_text.work: 一剪梅·红藕香残玉簟秋

art_direction.medium: luminous silver mineral-pigment architecture and expansive blue night air
art_direction.composition: A fully clothed adult stands on a sheltered open wooden gallery of a traditional Chinese west-facing residential pavilion, looking toward migrating geese beneath a luminous full moon. Architecture is unmistakably Chinese: dark timber columns and bracket sets, white plaster walls, a gray curved tile roof with modest upturned eaves, and a simple waist-high wooden balustrade. Absolutely no European architecture, church tower, turret, dome, spire, bell tower or fortress. A plain unmarked sealed letter packet rests in one hand. Geese are naturally spaced and form no readable characters. Silver clouds and blue night air occupy most of the view.
